description: Generate TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas, Pydantic models, or JSON Schema from the bodies of requests captured by a sandbox endpoint. Several requests of one event teach which fields are optional or nullable.

event.description: Only requests whose detected provider event matches, e.g. "invoice.paid" or "push". One event per schema gives the tightest types.

limit.description: How many of the latest requests to read before filtering

method.description: Only requests with this HTTP method

name.description: Root type name (default: from the detected event, else WebhookPayload)

requestIds.description: Use exactly these requests instead of the latest ones

name: generate_payload_schema
